The Opportunity

Firefly is the new family of creative generative AI models coming to Adobe products that offers a new way to conceptualise, build, and scale content. It’s a natural extension of the technology Adobe has produced over the past 40 years.

At the core of Firefly are our commercially safe AI models trained on hundreds of millions of images owned or licensed by Adobe. We are hiring for a highly strategic and visible role to help evolve these models and the associated prompt engine. This is an opportunity to reach millions of creatives, helping them recreate the way they work.

What you will Do
• Deliver end-to-end machine learning solutions that have organizational-wide impact using innovative architectures
• Contribute to the backend services for Firefly that power the generative AI features on Firefly website, Photoshop, Illustrator, Express, Stock and other applications/surfaces
• Develop GPU optimized, efficient model pipelines for new Firefly features serving a variety of modalities like images, vectors, 3D, etc.
• Ensure a scalable, reliable cloud service with observability, logging and tracing to enable quick detection, understanding and resolution of run-time issues
• Chip in to Project Colligo, the AI superhighway for inference that will handle and serve a collection of ML models in a highly scalable and resilient system
• Develop critical aspects of the business logic in the Firefly services to ensure metering of usage, entitlement checks, quota limits and upsell workflows
What you need to succeed
• PhD or Masters in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Vision, Robotics, related field or equivalent experience
• 4+ years of hands-on experience with PyTorch and Python in a production environment
• Strong Python and deep learning development skills and experience with one or more training or deployment environments (PyTorch, Tensorflow)
• Validated expertise in creation and optimization as well as operation of GPU intensive ML workloads in production environments
• Expertise in optimizing and deploying machine learning models on device
• Deep understanding of model serving, orchestration, scaling and GPU resource management
• Demonstrated experience productizing pipelines using generative models
• Strong critical thinking, analytical and quantitative problem-solving ability
• Excellent communication, relationship skills and a strong team player

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Come shape the future of our industry by bringing Artificial Intelligence capabilities to life!

Digital Core Tech@Lilly is actively looking for an Artificial Intelligence Data Engineer to build and fuel AI models and solutions that improve performance and reliability of processes and systems in pharma. Are you passionate about artificial intelligence and the impact it can have across an entire industry? Are you a change agent who can influence organizations? If so, bring YOUR skills and talents to Lilly where you’ll have the chance to create an impact on the lives of patients!

What You'll Be Doing

As our Artificial Intelligence Data Engineer, you will:

Data Pipeline Architecture: Design, construct, install, test, and maintain highly scalable data management systems. Ensure systems meet business requirements and industry practices.

Data Integration and Orchestration: Build high-performance algorithms, prototypes, predictive models, and proof of concepts. Integrate new data management technologies and software engineering tools into existing structures.

Data Storage and Processing: Implement data storage solutions that support the volume, velocity, and variety of data. Optimize data retrieval and develop dashboards, reports, and other visualizations for stakeholders.

Collaboration with AI Teams: Work closely with AI researchers, machine learning engineers, and software developers to ensure seamless integration of AI and machine learning models into the data ecosystem.

Continuous Improvement: Continuously monitor, test, and improve the performance of data management systems to ensure they meet the evolving needs of the business.

Innovation and Research: Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in AI, machine learning, and data engineering. Explore and adopt cutting-edge technologies and methodologies to enhance our AI capabilities.

How You'll Succeed

Technical Mastery in Data Engineering: Leverage your extensive knowledge in data engineering and architecture principles, along with your experience in building and optimizing data pipelines, architectures, and data sets.

Strategic Problem Solving: Utilize your problem-solving skills to design and implement innovative solutions that support AI initiatives and business objectives.

Agile Methodology: Apply agile and lean methodologies in managing data engineering projects, ensuring timely delivery and adaptability to change.

Collaborative Excellence: Excel in a collaborative environment, working alongside other AI professionals and stakeholders to integrate AI into our business processes seamlessly.

Innovation and Curiosity: Drive innovation by exploring new tools, technologies, and processes in AI and data engineering. Maintain a curious mindset, always looking for ways to improve and advance our capabilities.

What You Should Bring

Proven Experience: A solid track record in data engineering with a specific focus on AI-driven projects. Demonstrable experience with data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.

Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with big data tools (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, etc.), data pipeline and workflow management tools, and cloud services (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure). Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.

Data Modeling and Analytics: Expertise in data modeling, data warehousing, and building ETL pipelines. Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and how they are applied in big data platforms.

Communication Skills: Exceptional communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and articulate complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Your Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field.
• 2+ years of technology leadership experience with expertise in industry standard data engineering tools and practices.
• 1+ years of experience in working with AI technologies and tools, such as natural language processing (NLP), AI generation, machine learning algorithms, deep learning, etc.

Additional Preferences:
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, or other languages such as Java, R, C++, and JavaScript. Knowledge of related libraries and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and Scikit-learn.
• Understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum), version control systems (Git), containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
• Familiarity with data manipulation libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) and experience with SQL and NoSQL databases
• Knowledge of NLP techniques and tools focusing on text analysis and understanding such as sentiment analysis, text classification, entity recognition, and the use of libraries like NLTK, SpaCy, or Gensim
• Understanding of machine learning algorithms (supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, decision trees, logistic regression, etc.) and deep learning frameworks (such as TensorFlow, PyTorch)
• Deep understanding of and experience with advanced machine learning and deep learning techniques, particularly those related to generative models like GANs, autoencoders, and transformers. Knowledge of how to design, train, and optimize these models.

Additional Information:
• Position located in Indianapolis, Indiana working in a hybrid model. Remote work within the US may be considered.
• Travel may be required periodically.

Vision

Robust Intelligence's mission is to eliminate AI Risk. As we transition into a world that is adopting AI into automated decision processes, we inherit a great deal of risk. Data drift, misclassified data, prediction biases and adversarial input easily distort AI outputs and can have detrimental effects. In addition, with viral adoption of new Generative AI based APIs, new risk vectors like prompt injection, prompt extraction, PII exfiltration, factual inconsistency and hallucinations pose significant threat to organizations. Our flagship products are built to be integrated with existing AI systems and protect against real-time API based 3rd-party AI access to eliminate these risks.

Robust Intelligence is a leading provider of end-to-end AI security solutions for enterprises. Our cutting-edge technology automates the testing and validation of AI models, safeguarding organizations from security, ethical, and operational risks. Backed by prominent investors including Sequoia Capital and Tiger Global, we are proud to work with an expanding list of customers, including JPMorgan Chase, Expedia, ADP, IBM, Deloitte, and key players in the public sector such as the U.S. Intelligence Community and the Department of Defense.

Advancing the state of AI is a collaborative process that requires unusually varied skills and perspectives. To that end, we have built a multidisciplinary team with increasingly diverse backgrounds. Together, we're building the future of secure, trustworthy AI.

About The Role

Robust Intelligence is the leader in AI Security. There is no dearth of challenges to solve, the AI landscape is constantly evolving and the threat landscape is changing rapidly, this provides you with a fertile opportunity to build impactful solutions that make AI safe and secure for everyone.

As an ML Engineer build ML models and algorithmic approaches to detect and protect against AI security risks. You will develop deep domain knowledge in AI and security, you will touch all aspects of building detection techniques and deploying them to production environments. You are at home working with a cross-functional team of researchers, engineers, and security experts to design, develop and deploy innovative AI solutions.
As a MLE you will

• Track and identify AI security risks, experiment with latest ML techniques to build SoTA protections
• Be hands-on and build e2e ML workflows, experimentation pipelines, evaluation strategies. Deploy and productizing protection mechanisms.
• Work with Senior Engineers to understand with latest GenAI research and applications that lead to novel security risk
• Participate in red-teaming assessments to help uncover threats, to gather context and collect data used to solidify our products.
• You'll have the opportunity to contribute to our overall machine learning culture as a member of the team.

What we look for:

• A BS or MS in Computer Science/Engineering.
• A strong background in AI, machine learning, and deep learning.
• An attitude of hands-on learning and constant experimentation to decompose and understand problem areas.
• Strong programming skills in generic programming languages such as Python or Golang.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Technologies we use:

• Python and specifically numpy, pandas
• ML frameworks like pytorch, tensorflow, fastai, xgboost, catboost, lightgbm, sklearn etc
• GRPC for integrating with our platform

Where and how you can work

Our flagship campus is in Sydney, Australia. We also have a campus in Melbourne and co-working spaces in Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide. If you call New Zealand home, we have our Auckland co-working space too.

But you have choice in where and how you work. That means if you want to do your thing in the office (if you're near one), at home or a bit of both, it's up to you.

What you’d be doing in this role

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Associate Azure Machine Learning Engineer to join our dynamic technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning models using Azure Machine Learning, with a focus on time series forecasting.

Responsibilities and Duties:
• Utilize Python programming language to develop custom machine learning pipelines and integrate with Azure Machine Learning.
• Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models using Azure Machine Learning, leveraging techniques such as AutoML and custom model development.
